limitations: C23: The v1 source is a synthetic fixture folder and a staged file keychain read without prompting; the production source (v1's folder and the login Keychain, where macOS asks before each item is read) is the same read-only adapter's other branch and is not driven here.

C23: The interruption is the fixture crash hook (the import stops after an item is noted writing) followed by ending the app; every other commit point and rollback interruption is exercised by the imports_rollback suite.
C23: Spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded; AX roles, names and focus are inspected.

C23: C23-N08's keyboard pass turns on macOS Keyboard navigation (the global AppleKeyboardUIMode preference, which AppKit reads for a sheet's buttons) for its duration and restores the operator's own value afterwards; without it no app's destructive confirmation button is reachable by Tab, and Return cancels.
C24: Spoken VoiceOver output is not recorded (no operator listened); Accessibility roles, names, order and focus are inspected by every earlier chunk's driver on this bundle.
C24: Network evidence is sampled lsof output (0.5 s), not a packet capture; DNS through mDNSResponder is not attributed. Reconnect is the synthetic services becoming reachable again.

C24: The offline launch covers the categories this driver stages (imported cases, FP/FN reports, an import receipt, diagnostics); Academy, API Client, Gateway and Harness offline work is covered by C07, C14, C15, C17, C18, C20 and C21's drivers on this bundle (C24-N06).
C24: The fixture build keeps diagnostics under its data root (fixture-logs/); production builds keep them in macOS's logs folder for the app (D051).
C24: N01 exports without a sheet into the fixture data root; N07 drives the production NSSavePanel into a driver-owned temporary folder. No Accessibility tree is saved while a panel lists folders.

C24: WebKit processes are those that appeared with the launch (pgrep com.apple.WebKit before and after); another app's WebKit process started meanwhile would be sampled too, which can only add sockets, never hide one.
